observations: A large blocky head with a yellow flat-topped hat dominates the center; one eye socket holds a pink flower shape ringed in red, the other is a dark hollow.
Handwritten text fills the composition at multiple scales and angles: bold black lettering arcs across the top, magenta script clusters lower right, and cyan lettering sits bottom left.
The muted khaki-grey background carries faint circular washes and loose horizontal scribbles, while the figure is built from overlapping black outlines, red loops, and blue strokes.
reading: A blocky figure wears its credentials like tags—auction house names, art-world labels, and self-applied titles crowd every margin. The flower set into one eye socket reads as tender against the bared teeth below it. Text and image compete for the same surface, so neither fully wins. The mood swings between mockery and longing, and that tension holds the image together.
contextAngle: In the owned subset, this work sits at the title-order end of the nnxyz-numbered family, with nnxyz #64 as its nearest neighbor in both title order and recorded creation order. nnxyz #64 shares the same dense text-over-face structure and the word 'Memewasher,' making the thread between the two works specific.

connections.reason: Both works layer handwritten text at competing scales directly over a blocky face and both carry the word 'Memewasher,' making the visual and verbal overlap specific rather than incidental.

The bared-teeth mouth and dense scribble lines crossing the face appear in both works, but nnxyz nifty faces #124 strips away all text, sharpening the contrast between the two approaches to the same face structure.

lookingQuestion: Where does your eye settle first—on the flower inside the eye socket, the bared teeth, or the text—and what does that order suggest about how the image is weighted?
ambiguities: The small dark hanging figure upper left has a loosely drawn heart-shaped body and round ears; its exact form is unclear from the image.
nnxyz nnotb #82 shows no face or comparable text structure and was inspected but not selected as a connection.
